seoTitle: Automate Your Real Estate Business with Zapier (2026)
metaDescription: Connect real estate lead sources like Zillow and Facebook to your CRM with Zapier for instant lead routing and automated follow-ups.
intro: Slow follow-up is one of the fastest ways to lose a real estate lead. This guide shows how to connect lead sources like Zillow, Realtor.com, or Facebook Lead Ads to a real estate CRM through Zapier, mapping property details and triggering instant SMS or email responses so hot leads get assigned to agents right away.

steps.heading: Map your automation architecture
steps.body: Plan the pipeline from initial lead capture through to CRM entry and agent assignment.

steps.heading: Connect your lead source
steps.body: Set up your trigger app, connecting a source like Zillow, Realtor.com, or Facebook Lead Ads.

steps.heading: Authenticate and test
steps.body: Authenticate the lead portal and fetch fresh sample customer payloads to confirm the data structure.

steps.heading: Connect your real estate CRM
steps.body: Add your CRM action step, such as Follow Up Boss or KVCore, and map lead tokens into contact fields.

steps.heading: Configure custom property fields
steps.body: Set up parameters like property type, budget, and timeline so your CRM captures the full picture.

steps.heading: Automate instant follow-up
steps.body: Set up multi-step automation for immediate SMS alerts and email follow-ups, then verify the data flow before going live.

faq.question: Which lead sources can connect to my real estate CRM?
faq.answer: The tutorial covers connecting Zillow, Realtor.com, and Facebook Lead Ads as trigger sources.

faq.question: Which CRMs are supported for real estate?
faq.answer: Examples include Follow Up Boss, KVCore, and LionDesk as the CRM action apps.

faq.question: Can leads get an automatic text message right away?
faq.answer: Yes, multi-step automation can send immediate personalized SMS or email responses to maximize conversion rates.

faq.question: Can hot leads be routed to a specific agent automatically?
faq.answer: Yes, internal team notification alerts can be set up to instantly assign hot leads to active agents.
